decisions.why: the site's own product taxonomy puts every product in one 'Uncategorised' bucket (no division structure), but the 56 named products (read from the site's own product records, so names are exact) are unambiguously GI endoscopy accessories spanning several of the gated types at once: general endoscopy consumables (biopsy forceps, guidewires, dilation balloons), access & retrieval devices (foreign body forceps, retrieval nets), endourology stone retrieval (stone extraction baskets/balloons), snares & resection (DailySnare, Coldsnare, ENDOx Polypectome), and haemostasis clips (Lockado Haemostasis Clip, coagulation forceps) -> list mapping per Lou's 25/08/2026 rule, same shape already applied to Croyde Medical's own 'Uncategorised' division.
